title: A countable family of test forms determines currents
statement: For all P, k ∈ ℕ and every open U ⊆ ℝ^P there is a countable set E ⊆ D^k(U) (= TestFormOn U k) such that any two currents S, R ∈ D_k(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U k) with S(e) = R(e) for all e ∈ E are equal.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∃ E : Set (TestFormOn U k), E.Countable ∧ ∀ S R : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ e ∈ E, S e = R e) → S = R
